doc: Exclusive write ownership for the game workstreams. Each path under the governed roots must match exactly one owner (checked by tools/ownership/check_ownership.py). Read access is unrestricted. Changing this file is a lead decision.

protected_reference.doc: Python Damage Lab: the validation reference. Writes are blocked by .claude/hooks/guard_paths.py unless SHARPWR_ALLOW_REFERENCE_EDIT=1 is set by the user for a deliberate reference change.

shared_contracts.doc: Owned by combat-engineer, consumed by everyone. Changes follow the contract-change protocol (.claude/rules/integration.md): ADR, consumer sign-off, all suites green.

lead.doc: Main session / engineering director. Architecture, plans, configuration, rosters (product/IP decisions).

combat-engineer.doc: Deterministic simulation core: numerics, time, scheduler, events, stats, damage pipeline, status effects, items/runes runtime, world/entities.

champion-implementer.doc: Ability framework content and per-champion scripts: data-driven definitions, ability hooks, original champion/item/rune content.

unity-gameplay.doc: Unity presentation and the engine-agnostic client core (fixed-step host, input mapping, view model): rendering, camera, input (touch + desktop), HUD, VFX/audio hookup, scenes. Never decides combat outcomes.

gameplay-ai.doc: Bots, minion/tower/monster target selection, difficulty policies. Runs inside the sim using only legal observations.

network-engineer.doc: Server-authoritative networking: protocol, input commands, snapshots, prediction/reconciliation, lag compensation, headless server.

data-verification.doc: Data migration from the Damage Lab, provenance, parity fixtures, content schema and validation.

qa.doc: Test infrastructure, parity/integration/acceptance suites, CI, lint and ownership tooling, milestone acceptance reports.
